reason: Primary purpose is enabling image sending in text-only model workflows inside DeepSeek Harness by bridging client image input to local attachment storage and model-facing path text, then letting existing vision/MCP tools consume the image paths, which matches a media-tooling automation function rather than development or analysis tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中为文本模型补齐图片发送能力：图片先落盘到会话 `.attachments/`，再以模型可见路径文本供视觉/MCP 工具识别。
summaries.en: This plugin enables image sending for text-only models in DeepSeek Harness by saving images to session attachments and forwarding a model-visible path token for vision/MCP tool recognition.

capabilities: Writes uploaded images to the workspace attachment directory.
Intercepts model capability checks and agent request flow for message handling.
Rewrites user-image content to model-visible path text for downstream vision/MCP processing.
